import json,base64,hashlib,shlex,xml.etree.ElementTree as E; from pathlib import Path
root=Path("docs/agent/implementation-runs"); old=root/"managed-20261023-integrate-lifecycle-01"; new=root/"managed-20261023-verify-lifecycle-01"
def captured(path):
 data=json.loads(path.read_bytes()); raw=data["output"].encode() if "output" in data else base64.b64decode(data["outputBase64"])
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==data["outputSha256"]
 return {"path":str(path),"exitCode":data["exitCode"],"outputSha256":data["outputSha256"],"command":shlex.join(data["command"])}
def suites(path):
 records=json.loads(path.read_bytes()); result=[]; identities=[]
 for p,item in records.items():
  raw=base64.b64decode(item["base64"],validate=True); assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==item["sha256"]
  xml=E.fromstring(raw); assert xml.attrib==item["tests"]
  for t in xml.findall("testcase"):
   result.append({"class":t.attrib["classname"],"name":t.attrib["name"],"pass":t.find("failure") is None and t.find("error") is None and t.find("skipped") is None})
  identities.extend(line for line in (xml.findtext("system-out") or "").splitlines() if line.startswith(("OWNED integration", "CLEANUP removed", "PostgreSQL server_version=")))
 return result,identities
initial,_=suites(old/"affected-01-junit.json"); follow,_=suites(old/"affected-02-junit.json")
union={(t["class"],t["name"]):t for t in initial+follow}; failures=[t for t in initial if not t["pass"]]
assert len(initial)==81 and len(failures)==1 and len(follow)==10 and all(t["pass"] for t in union.values())
fresh,containers=suites(new/"targeted-junit.json"); cross,_=suites(new/"cross-row-junit.json")
assert len(fresh)==11 and len(cross)==1 and all(t["pass"] for t in fresh+cross)
assert len([x for x in containers if x.startswith("OWNED")])==3
assert len([x for x in containers if x.startswith("CLEANUP")])==3
